pages.text: Build a $(l)Library$() (Scholarship) for research points. Research is paid in points plus some items and has five branches: $(l)Economy$(), $(l)Construction$(), $(l)Scholarship$(), $(l)Smithing$() and $(l)Military$().$(br2)It unlocks buildings, tiers, materials and unit types. Cancelling keeps the progress banked.

$(l)Highlights$()$(li)Masonry / Architecture / Urban Planning / Royal Charter: tier gates$(li)Carpentry, Engineering: faster builders$(li)Command: more soldiers and Royal Guards$(li)Veteran Training: soldiers start at level 3$(li)Dragon Riders: train dragon-mounted bowmen$(li)Education: faster research
